preview.//: Installable APK for demo phones. buildType 'apk' matters: the default for a production Android build is an AAB, which cannot be sideloaded.

env.//: Baked into the bundle at build time. Must be the LAN address of the laptop running the backend — not localhost, which on a phone means the phone itself. Override per build with: EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL=http://192.168.x.x:8000 eas build ...

production.//: AAB for Play Store submission. Not sideloadable — use 'preview' for demo phones.
